name: cadence.account.get
description: Read the member on file, the plan summary, credits, trial status, upcoming reservation and waitlist counts, and the confirmation setting. Returns signed_out while the session is expired, like every other operation.

name: cadence.plan.get
description: Read the plan: type, credits, free-trial status and end date, trial rules, renewal date, what renews, any scheduled change, the masked payment method and the receipts on file.

name: cadence.payment_methods.list
description: List payment methods on file, masked, with their status (ok or declined).

name: cadence.classes.search
description: Browse upcoming classes by type, studio, neighborhood, day, time window and text. Each class carries its price under the member's plan (included, a credit cost, or not available with the reason), spots left, rating and whether the member already holds a reservation or waitlist place. Full classes are listed when include_full is true.

name: cadence.classes.get
description: Read one class instance with its studio, instructor, price under the plan, spots left, cancellation deadline and the member's reservation or waitlist place on it.

name: cadence.studios.get
description: Read one studio: location, distance, ratings, amenities, instructors, whether the member has visited, and its upcoming classes priced under the plan.

name: cadence.studios.image
description: Read the bytes of a studio's image (PNG) by studio ID. A studio without an image returns no_image.

name: cadence.reservations.list
description: List reservations with class and studio details. Upcoming booked reservations flag an overlap with another reservation as conflict; a reservation whose class time was moved is marked time_changed.

name: cadence.reservations.get
description: Read one reservation with its history, cancellation deadline and whether cancelling now would be late.

name: cadence.waitlist.list
description: List waitlist entries with their position, status and any open offer.

name: cadence.reservations.preview
description: Prepare a booking: the price under the plan, the cancellation deadline and an expiry. Errors: class_full (join the waitlist instead), overlap (names the conflicting reservation), not_included (with the reason), insufficient_credits, outside_horizon, invalid_state. Nothing is booked.

name: cadence.reservations.confirm
description: Book the class prepared by reservations.preview (id is the preview ID) and charge credits under the plan, or record that it was included. Errors: preview_stale with the current price when the preview expired or the class changed (and a waitlist hint when it is now full), approval_required while user confirmation is required and not yet given.

name: cadence.reservations.cancel_preview
description: Prepare a cancellation (id is the reservation ID): whether it is inside the free window, the late fee or forfeited credits otherwise, and an expiry. A cancellation inside the window needs no preview.

name: cadence.reservations.cancel
description: Cancel a booked reservation (id is the reservation ID). Inside the free window credits are returned at once. After the deadline the call must name a live cancel preview in preview_id, the late fee is charged to the payment method or the credits are forfeited, and user confirmation applies when required.

name: cadence.reservations.reschedule
description: Move a booked reservation (id is the reservation ID) to another scheduled instance at the same studio with the same price under the plan. Errors: class_full, overlap, not_included, price_changed, outside_horizon.

name: cadence.reservations.checkin
description: Check in to a booked class (id is the reservation ID) from checkin_opens_minutes before the start until its end. Error: checkin_window.

name: cadence.reservations.rate
description: Rate an attended class (id is the reservation ID) from 1 to 5 with an optional review, once the class has ended. Errors: not_attended, too_early, already_rated.

name: cadence.waitlist.join
description: Join the waitlist of a full class. The same price and overlap checks as a booking apply. Errors: not_full, overlap, not_included, insufficient_credits, invalid_state.

name: cadence.waitlist.leave
description: Leave the waitlist (id is the waitlist entry ID).

name: cadence.waitlist.accept
description: Accept an open offer (id is the waitlist entry ID) and book the class under the plan. Errors: offer_expired, class_full, overlap, insufficient_credits, approval_required when credits are charged and user confirmation is required.

name: cadence.waitlist.decline
description: Decline an open offer (id is the waitlist entry ID).

name: cadence.plan.preview
description: Prepare a plan change (action change with plan_id) or a cancellation (action cancel): the effective date, the charge and credit difference, and an expiry. Changes take effect at the next renewal; a trial can only be cancelled at its end, and the preview shows that date. Errors: change_pending, payment_declined, same_plan, unknown_plan, invalid_state.

name: cadence.plan.change
description: Schedule the plan change prepared by plan.preview (id is the preview ID) for its effective date. Errors: preview_stale, change_pending, approval_required.

name: cadence.plan.cancel
description: Cancel the plan as prepared by plan.preview (id is the preview ID): the account keeps its access until the effective date and does not renew. Errors: preview_stale, change_pending, approval_required.
